title: uxcli version
description: A version of a journey — .uxcli/versions/<journey>/<name>.json: a name given to one walk of it, so it is kept against pruning and can be compared with another (uxcli experience --from --to). Created by uxcli version save, never edited.

note.description: what changed in this version, in words

build.description: the commit the walk ran against

proposal.description: the redesign proposal this version answers
